Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a historical time period with a “time of” phrase. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，The pattern means taking the child along when moving; 跟孩子搬家 does not express this relationship as precisely. [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，别的 distinguishes other people or things from a stated one, while 另一个 means one additional/different city. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟母：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他和妈妈，This is the first mention of the main character, so introduce him with his name and identity before using later references. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子：他，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes with him, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市里，那个城市 suggests that the city has already been identified, but it has not been mentioned; this fuller phrase makes the place clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住了在靠墓地的家：住在墓地旁边的家里，了 cannot come before the locative complement; moreover, 住 describes an ongoing living state here, so it does not take 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]
8. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A routine marked by 每天 uses the zero particle rather than 了, because the sentence does not describe one completed act. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬了到别一个城市：搬到了另一个城市，Put 了 after the resultative/directional complement 到: 搬到了 marks that the move was completed. [teacher rule: le_placement]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
跟孩子搬家 is grammatical and naturally means moving together with the child; 带着孩子 is only an optional rewording.
别一个城市 is not the appropriate expression for another city; 另一个城市 is correct.
孟子和孟母 already uses proper names on first mention, while the proposed replacement ends with the incomplete phrase 他和妈妈.
孩子 is vague here, and 他 can clearly refer back to the recently named 孟子.
那个城市 presupposes an identified city, whereas 在他们住的城市里 makes the reference clear.
住了在 has incorrect 了 placement, and the ongoing state of living here should not take 了.
每天 describes a habitual action, so 祭拜 should not take completed-action 了.
搬了到 has incorrect 了 placement, and 别一个城市 must be changed to 另一个城市.
